note: Operator branding link -- renders the fixed Amazon home/logo control.
Search category control -- renders the fixed operator-defined department vocabulary and its menu options.
Search submission control -- renders the fixed operator search action.
Primary shopping navigation -- renders fixed operator controls and department navigation.
Cart navigation control -- renders the fixed Cart vocabulary and its computed cart indicator.
Account-menu control -- renders the fixed account-menu disclosure action, excluding the personalized account link text.
Search-results sort control -- renders the fixed sorting vocabulary.
Amazon footer chrome -- renders fixed back-to-top, service, legal, company, help, payment, and operator information links, excluding user-selectable locale controls.
